name: regenerate_plugin_boilerplate
description: Picks up a template/tooling fix (a change to how this tool set generates plugin.py/main.py/version.py/install.sh) on a plugin that was already generated, without re-supplying the whole original generate_plugin_scaffold call. Reads back generation_inputs.json (written by generate_plugin_scaffold itself) and re-renders ONLY plugin.py, main.py, version.py, and install.sh with today's template code -- the existing override_bodies/authorize/ai_enabled/etc. are reused exactly as originally supplied, nothing LLM-authored needs to be retyped. Never touches server_entry.json (its live, host-assigned nsid would be lost), profile.json, README.md, LICENSE.md, tests, or node-class files -- those are content, not template output. Also the right tool for a pure version bump with nothing else changing: pass 'version' and it updates version.py, generation_inputs.json's own version field, and appends a context.md entry -- no evidence or discovery-tool call needed first, since a version bump alone introduces no new content to source. Fails clearly if generation_inputs.json doesn't exist yet (plugins generated before this tool existed need one generate_plugin_scaffold call first). Tell the developer before calling this -- it overwrites the 4 template files above unconditionally. Also refreshes OS permissions on the written files once after writing -- a hub-side failure there is reported back as a non-fatal 'permissions_refresh_error' field and never means the files weren't written. This also notifies the platform of every file written -- a hub-side failure there is reported back as a non-fatal 'files_changed_notify_error' field and never means the change itself failed.

location.description: The subdirectory name under the server's plugin output root -- the same 'location' generate_plugin_scaffold/read_generated_plugin use.

version.description: Optional. When given and different from this plugin's currently stored version, performs a pure version bump: renders version.py with this value, updates generation_inputs.json's version field, and appends a context.md entry. Omit to just refresh the 4 template files with today's code, unchanged version.

iteration_note.description: Optional free-text note for the context.md entry when version is given and actually changes -- defaults to a plain 'Version bumped X -> Y.' note if omitted. Ignored when version is omitted or unchanged.
